title: Read one lawless system next to our border whole: deposits, creatures, stations, order books, mission boards
note: Kept by Oracle (orders F13); the command group flies it too. Started 2026-11-15 with the six systems one or two jumps beyond our border; Atlas and Intercrus join when the fuel for the way is known. Lawless space: no police. A system where a ship of ours was lost leaves the list until Military has looked at it. Hold empty on the way out.
